reviewer.report:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Restrict email:send scope to send tool only",
      "body": "isAuthorized grants any email.* gated tool when the caller presents email:send, so isAuthorized('email.accounts.delete','email:send') returns true and a send-only token can delete an account and its drafts/outbox/cache via deleteAccount. The manifest describes delete as requiring admin/profile:write_danger, so send scope must not imply delete.",
      "priority": 1,
      "confidence": 0.9,
      "file_path": "mcp/src/auth.ts",
      "line_start": 336,
      "line_end": 345
    },
    {
      "title": "Scope draft update and readback by account",
      "body": "saveDraft looks up the draft by id alone, then runs UPDATE WHERE id AND account_id, then reads back by id alone. Reusing an id owned by another account makes the UPDATE affect zero rows and returns the other account's row unchanged, so the caller sees a successful save of stale foreign data while nothing was written.",
      "priority": 1,
      "confidence": 0.85,
      "file_path": "src/main/email/manager.ts",
      "line_start": 210,
      "line_end": 219
    },
    {
      "title": "Scope flags cache update by folder",
      "body": "setMessageFlags selects and updates email_messages_cache by account_id and uid only, but UIDs are folder-scoped and the cache key is (account_id, folder, uid). With the same UID present in INBOX and Sent, flagging one folder reads and rewrites the other folder's row, corrupting cached seen/flagged state.",
      "priority": 2,
      "confidence": 0.85,
      "file_path": "src/main/email/manager.ts",
      "line_start": 340,
      "line_end": 349
    }
  ],
  "overall_correctness": "incorrect",
  "overall_explanation": "Patch adds real mail-profile value but ships a send-scope privilege overreach plus two account/folder scoping defects that silently corrupt or leak drafts and flags. Lean already.",
  "overall_confidence_score": 0.85
}
